vocab.sentence: We have the freedom to choose our own clothes.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們有選擇自己衣服的自由。

vocab.sentence: There is a stone statue in front of the museum.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 博物館前面有一座石雕像。

vocab.sentence: Jasmine chewed gum to remove the smell of garlic.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Jasmine 嚼口香糖來去除大蒜味。

vocab.sentence: We had a party in celebration of winning the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們開派對慶祝贏得比賽。

vocab.sentence: The country gained independence more than fifty years ago.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個國家在五十多年前獲得獨立。

vocab.sentence: The monument was built to remember a great leader.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座紀念碑是為了紀念一位偉大的領袖而建造的。

vocab.sentence: The white flowers symbolize peace in this story.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在這個故事中，這些白花象徵和平。

vocab.sentence: Jack firmly closed the lid of the jar so that it wouldn't open accidentally.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Jack 牢牢蓋上罐子的蓋子，以免它意外打開。

vocab.sentence: Amy was chosen to represent her class in the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Amy 被選出來代表她的班級參加比賽。

vocab.sentence: We visited an ancient city during our trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在旅行中參觀了一座古城。

vocab.sentence: People in slavery were forced to work without pay.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 處於奴隸身分的人被迫無償工作。

vocab.sentence: It is unfair to blame her for your mistake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 因為你自己的錯誤而責怪她是不公平的。

vocab.sentence: The workers complained about the unfair treatment they received.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 工人們抱怨自己受到的不公平待遇。

vocab.sentence: The tourist asked me how to get to the museum.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位遊客問我如何前往博物館。

vocab.chinese: 有吸引力的事物或地點
vocab.sentence: The old castle is a popular tourist attraction.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座古堡是一個熱門的觀光景點。

vocab.sentence: The tall tower has become a famous city landmark.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座高塔已成為著名的城市地標。

vocab.sentence: People around the globe watched the game on TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 世界各地的人們在電視上觀看這場比賽。

phrases.sentence: Even though it was raining, we still went out.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 儘管當時正在下雨，我們還是出門了。

phrases.sentence: Close to fifty people visited the museum today.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 今天有將近五十人參觀博物館。

phrases.sentence: The work became easier over time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 隨著時間過去，這份工作變得更容易了。

phrases.sentence: We paid a visit to the old museum yesterday.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們昨天參觀了那座老博物館。

phrases.sentence: As always, Ben arrived at school early.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 如往常一樣，Ben 很早就到學校了。

grammar.sentence: We have the freedom to choose our own future.

grammar.sentence: Even though it rained, the celebration still went on.

grammar.sentence: They held a party in celebration of gaining independence.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們開派對慶祝獲得獨立。

grammar.sentence: The old statue has been moved to the museum.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那座舊雕像已經被移到博物館了。

grammar.sentence: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will visit the museum.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 即使明天下雨，我們仍會參觀博物館。

grammar.sentence: Amy was chosen to represent our class this year.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Amy 今年被選出來代表我們班。

grammar.sentence: The guard stopped us from walking on the grass.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 警衛阻止我們踩草地。

grammar.sentence: Even though the museum was crowded, we enjoyed our visit.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 儘管博物館很擁擠，我們仍享受這次參觀。

grammar.sentence: It is important to treat every worker fairly.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 公平對待每一位工人很重要。

grammar.sentence: The tourists thanked the guide for showing them the monument.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 遊客們感謝導遊帶他們看紀念碑。

grammar.sentence: The ancient wall must be repaired before next summer.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這道古牆必須在明年夏天之前修好。

grammar.sentence: Even if we are tired, we will finish the tour.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 即使我們很累，我們仍會完成這趟遊覽。

grammar.sentence: We paid a visit to the museum to learn more.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們參觀博物館，以了解更多事情。

grammar.sentence: After visiting the landmark, we went to a restaurant.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 參觀地標後，我們去了一間餐廳。

grammar.sentence: The tourist was treated at a small local hospital.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位遊客在當地一家小醫院接受治療。

grammar.sentence: Even though he was young, he understood the problem.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 儘管他年紀小，他仍了解這個問題。

grammar.sentence: Everyone should have the freedom to choose a job.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 每個人都應該有選擇工作的自由。

grammar.sentence: They protected the statue by covering it with cloth.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們用布蓋住雕像來保護它。

grammar.sentence: The celebration will be held in the town square.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 慶祝活動將在鎮上的廣場舉行。

grammar.sentence: Even if the shop is closed, we can return tomorrow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 即使商店關門了，我們也可以明天再來。

grammar.sentence: The guide asked the tourists to stay together.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 導遊要求遊客們待在一起。

grammar.sentence: The worker apologized for leaving tools near the statue.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那名工人為把工具留在雕像旁而道歉。

grammar.sentence: The heavy door should be closed firmly at night.

grammar.sentence: Even though the treatment was unfair, she remained calm.

grammar.sentence: The museum allows visitors to take photos without flash.

grammar.sentence: We learned about slavery by reading this history book.

grammar.sentence: People around the globe were invited to the celebration.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 世界各地的人們都受邀參加慶祝活動。

tips.label: to 後用原形
tips.text: freedom to V 表示做某事的自由；表目的的 to V 也用原形動詞。

tips.label: 介系詞後用 V-ing
tips.text: stop someone from V-ing、in celebration of V-ing；by、for、without 後接動作也用 V-ing。

tips.label: 被動語態
tips.text: 主詞接受動作時，用 be＋過去分詞；時態放在 be 或前面的助動詞上。

tips.label: 儘管與即使
tips.text: even though 說明事實，even if 提出假設；兩者後面都要有完整子句。

notes.title: 本份文法範圍與來源
notes.description: 照片提供的是 Lesson 6 單字與片語頁，未附獨立文法頁。本份教學筆記及題目以照片中的 freedom to V、stop someone from V-ing、介系詞後接動名詞、被動語態與 even though／even if 為範圍；選擇題與文法重組句均由 AI 新編。
examples: We have the freedom to choose our future.
Even though it rained, we went out.

notes.title: 不定詞與目的
notes.description: freedom 後的 to V 說明做某事的自由。to V 也可說明動作目的，例如建造紀念碑是為了紀念某人。to 後面不加 -s、不用過去式或 V-ing。be used to V 在照片的 medicine 例句中表示「被用來做……」，與 be used to＋名詞／V-ing 表示「習慣於……」不同。
examples: We have the freedom to choose where to live.
The monument was built to honor a great leader.
This medicine is used to treat diabetes.

notes.title: 介系詞後接動名詞
notes.description: 介系詞後如果接動作，動詞要變成 V-ing。stop someone from V-ing 表示阻止某人做某事；in celebration of V-ing 表示慶祝某件事；by V-ing 表示透過某種方法。before／after 後若直接接動作且沒有子句主詞，也用 V-ing。這與 before／after＋主詞＋限定動詞的完整子句不同。
examples: The guard stopped us from touching the statue.
They had a party in celebration of winning the game.
After visiting the museum, we went home.

notes.title: 被動語態的基本形式
notes.description: 主詞是接受動作的人或物時，用被動語態。例如雕像被發現、紀念碑被建造、遊客被治療。現在式用 am／is／are，過去式用 was／were；動詞本身用過去分詞。常見不規則變化有 build→built、choose→chosen、find→found、see→seen、show→shown。
examples: The ancient statue was found in the river.
Amy was chosen to represent her class.

notes.title: 帶助動詞的被動語態
notes.description: 情態動詞後用原形 be，再接過去分詞。完成式被動用 has／have／had been＋過去分詞；進行式被動用 am／is／are being＋過去分詞。比較：will be held（將被舉行）、has been repaired（已被修復）、are being shown（正在被帶領參觀）。
examples: The celebration will be held next Sunday.
The wall has been repaired twice.
The tourists are being shown around the museum.

notes.title: even though 與 even if
notes.rule: even though／even if＋主詞＋限定動詞
notes.description: even though 表示「儘管」，引出已發生或被視為確定的事實；even if 表示「即使」，提出假設的條件。兩者後面都要有完整子句。even if 談未來條件時通常用現在式，主要子句可用 will。even though 本身已表示讓步，一般不再用 but 連接同一組子句。
examples: Even though it was raining, we went out.
Even if it rains tomorrow, we will go out.
Even though they are young, they understand the problem.

quiz.question: We have the freedom to ______ our own future.
quiz.hint: to 後接原形動詞；freedom to choose 表示選擇的自由。

quiz.question: This room is used to ______ visitors about ancient life.
quiz.hint: be used to 在這裡表示「被用來」，後面接原形動詞 teach。

quiz.question: The tourist decided to ______ a photo of the statue.
quiz.hint: decided to 後面用原形動詞 take；過去時間已由 decided 表示。

quiz.question: The workers have the freedom to ______ their own leader.
quiz.hint: freedom to 後面接原形動詞，不會因主詞是 workers 而改變。

quiz.question: Amy was chosen to ______ her class in the game.
quiz.hint: was chosen to 後面接原形動詞 represent；不要在 to 後面再加時態變化。

quiz.question: We went to the museum to ______ the ancient statues.
quiz.hint: 第二個 to 表示目的，後接原形動詞 see，意思是為了看古代雕像。

quiz.question: The guide showed us how to ______ the cover safely.
quiz.hint: how to 後接原形動詞 remove，表示如何移開覆蓋物。

quiz.question: The people have the freedom ______ where to live.
quiz.hint: freedom 後面用 to 加原形動詞說明自由的內容，所以用 to choose。

quiz.question: The monument was built to ______ a great leader.
quiz.hint: to 表示建造紀念碑的目的，後接原形動詞 honor。

quiz.question: A guide offered to ______ the tourists find the landmark.
quiz.hint: offered to 後面接原形動詞 help；空格前已有 to。

quiz.question: We paid a visit to the museum to ______ more about ancient life.
quiz.hint: 句尾 to 表示參觀的目的，後接原形動詞 learn。

quiz.question: The guide asked the tourists to ______ together.
quiz.hint: ask someone to 後接原形動詞 stay，表示要求某人待在一起。

quiz.question: The guard stopped the tourist from ______ the statue.
quiz.hint: stop someone from 後接動名詞 V-ing，所以 touch 要變成 touching。

quiz.question: They removed the old paint before ______ the statue.
quiz.hint: before 在這裡後接動作，且沒有子句主詞，因此用動名詞 repairing。

quiz.question: We had a party in celebration of ______ the game.
quiz.hint: of 是介系詞，後面用動名詞；win 的動名詞要雙寫 n 再加 ing。

quiz.question: The driver prevented the children from ______ the busy road.
quiz.hint: prevent someone from 與 stop someone from 一樣，from 後接動名詞 crossing。

quiz.question: The worker was thanked for ______ the monument.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 cleaning，表示因清理紀念碑而受到感謝。

quiz.question: After ______ the ancient city, the tourists went home.
quiz.hint: After 後沒有子句主詞，直接接動作時用動名詞 visiting。

quiz.question: We protect the statue by ______ it with a large cloth.
quiz.hint: by 後接動名詞，表示透過某個方法，因此用 covering。

quiz.question: Amy is proud of ______ her class at the celebration.
quiz.hint: of 是介系詞，後面的 represent 要變成動名詞 representing。

quiz.question: Close to forty tourists left without ______ the guide.
quiz.hint: without 後接動名詞 telling，表示沒有告訴導遊就離開了。

quiz.question: The fence stopped visitors from ______ the old building.
quiz.hint: stop someone from 後面用 V-ing，所以 enter 要改為 entering。

quiz.question: They celebrated their independence by ______ a street party.
quiz.hint: by 表示方法，後接動名詞 holding；held 是過去式或過去分詞。

quiz.question: The visitor apologized for ______ waste near the landmark.
quiz.hint: for 後接動名詞 leaving，表示為留下垃圾這件事道歉。

quiz.question: The ancient statue was ______ in the river last year.
quiz.hint: statue 是被發現的物品；被動語態為 was 加過去分詞 found。

quiz.question: That monument was ______ more than fifty years ago.
quiz.hint: 紀念碑是被建造的，was 後接 build 的過去分詞 built。

quiz.question: Amy was ______ to represent her class at the celebration.
quiz.hint: Amy 是被選出來的，was 後接 choose 的過去分詞 chosen。

quiz.question: The old signs were ______ from the museum yesterday.
quiz.hint: signs 是被移除的物品，were 後用過去分詞 removed。

quiz.question: The injured tourist was ______ by a local doctor.
quiz.hint: by a local doctor 指出動作執行者，遊客是被治療的人，故用 was treated。

quiz.question: The celebration will ______ in the park next Sunday.
quiz.hint: celebration 是被舉辦的活動，未來被動語態為 will be 加過去分詞 held。

quiz.question: The park is ______ by many tourists every summer.
quiz.hint: 公園是被遊客造訪的地方，is 後接過去分詞 visited。

quiz.question: The ancient wall has been ______ twice since last year.
quiz.hint: has been 後接過去分詞 repaired，構成現在完成式的被動語態。

quiz.question: The heavy door must ______ firmly before we leave.
quiz.hint: 門需要被關上，情態動詞 must 後用 be 加過去分詞 closed。

quiz.question: The flag was ______ during the independence celebration.
quiz.hint: 旗子是被升起的，was 後用過去分詞 raised。

quiz.question: The tall statue can ______ clearly from the road.
quiz.hint: 雕像是被看見的，can 後面的被動語態為 be seen。

quiz.question: The workers were ______ fairly by their new boss.
quiz.hint: 工人是受到對待的人，by their new boss 指出對待他們的人，所以用 were treated。

quiz.question: The tourists are being ______ around the museum now.
quiz.hint: 遊客正在被帶領參觀；現在進行式被動語態為 are being 加過去分詞 shown。

quiz.question: The monument had been ______ before the tourists arrived.
quiz.hint: had been 後用過去分詞 completed，表示在遊客到達前已被完成。

quiz.question: Even though she ______ tired after the tour yesterday, she still visited the monument.
quiz.hint: yesterday 指出過去時間；she 是單數主詞，子句用 was tired，不能省略限定動詞。

quiz.question: Even though the museum ______ closed yesterday, we enjoyed the nearby park.
quiz.hint: yesterday 與 enjoyed 都指過去，museum 是單數，子句中的 be 動詞用 was。

quiz.question: Even though it ______ raining, the celebration continued as planned.
quiz.hint: continued 表示過去情境；it 搭配 was，再接 raining 構成過去進行式。

quiz.question: Even if the statue ______ repaired next week, we will keep the fence around it.
quiz.hint: even if 引導未來條件時，子句用現在式；單數 statue 的被動語態用 is repaired。

quiz.question: Even though he ______ little freedom when he was a child, he never lost hope.
quiz.hint: when he was a child 指出過去時間，主要子句也用 lost，因此空格用 have 的過去式 had。

quiz.question: Even if there ______ many tourists tomorrow, we will visit the landmark.
quiz.hint: even if 的未來條件子句用現在式；many tourists 是複數，there 後用 are。

quiz.question: Even though the tourists ______ late, they still stopped to take photos.
quiz.hint: stopped 表示過去情境；the tourists 是複數主詞，所以子句用 were late。

quiz.question: Even if Tom ______ time tomorrow, he will stay home to rest.
quiz.hint: even if 的未來條件子句用現在式；Tom 是第三人稱單數，所以用 has。

quiz.question: Even though she ______ at the museum yesterday, she did not see the new statue.
quiz.hint: yesterday 指出過去時間，even though 子句仍需要限定動詞，因此用 worked。

quiz.question: Even though this monument ______ ancient, it is still in good condition.
quiz.hint: this monument 是單數主詞；現在式用 is，再接形容詞 ancient。

quiz.question: Even if it ______ tomorrow, we will pay a visit to the museum.
quiz.hint: even if 引導未來條件時用現在式；it 是第三人稱單數，所以用 rains。

quiz.question: Even though Peter and Amy ______ young, they understand why freedom matters.
quiz.hint: even though 後面仍要有正確的主詞與動詞搭配；Peter and Amy 是複數，現在式用 are。
